name: io.github.haechiwood/n8n-preflight
title: n8n Preflight
description: Lint exported n8n workflow JSON: failure patterns, leaked secrets, Creator Hub readiness

environmentVariables.name: N8N_PREFLIGHT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder the server may read workflow .json files from. Default: current directory

environmentVariables.name: N8N_PREFLIGHT_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable write_sanitized_copy (preview first, confirm to write)
